episodes.title: Wolf und Adler
episodes.summary: Cherusci tribal chief Segimer bristles at the increasing demands of new governor Varus. Secret lovers Thusnelda and Folkwin deal Rome a symbolic blow.

episodes.title: Die Vergeltung
episodes.summary: The theft of the standard provokes a crisis, reuniting Roman officer Ari with his father Segimer, and childhood friends Folkwin and Thusnelda.

episodes.title: Am Abgrund
episodes.summary: Ari commands troops ordered by Varus to hunt down and kill Folkwin, whose family and home village are put in danger for his act of defiance.

episodes.title: Ein neuer Reik
episodes.summary: Ari embraces his new role with the Cherusci but his shift of allegiances runs deeper than Varus knows. Thusnelda and Folkwin rally a rival tribe.

episodes.title: Der Verrat
episodes.summary: Ari and Thusnelda forge a political marriage and begin uniting the fractious Germanic tribes. Folkwin is believed dead but has actually been enslaved.

episodes.title: Die Schlacht
episodes.summary: Ari leads Varus and three Roman legions into the Teutoburg Forest — and into history. Thusnelda makes a bloody sacrifice to preserve the alliance.

episodes.title: Neue Legionen
episodes.summary: Ari suspects the Romans of rebuilding their forces, so he seeks the help of an eastern tribal chief, Marbod. Ari's father, Flavus, arrives in Germania.

episodes.title: Gefangen
episodes.summary: A friend comes to Thusnelda's aid when she infiltrates the Roman camp. Without Ari knowing, Marbod meets with Tiberius in a bid to secure peace.

episodes.title: Väter
episodes.summary: Germanicus accuses Flavus of being a traitor. Ari brings Gaius to the village and then seeks revenge against Marbod. Thusnelda is angry at Ari for lying.

episodes.title: Der Schwur
episodes.summary: Tiberius requires a test of Marbod's loyalty. Flavus proposes an offer to Germanicus. The tribal chiefs gather to name Marbod king but tragedy strikes.

episodes.title: Verloren
episodes.summary: Marbod confronts Tiberius and demands justice. Thusnelda and Folkwin set out on a mission. Gaius hides out in the forest and makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Der Preis
episodes.summary: The tribes prepare to attack the Roman camps before ships with reinforcements arrive. Segestes approaches Tiberius with a treacherous proposal.
